hero.heading: Coffee roasted on Wednesday, on your bar by Friday.
hero.intro: We roast in small batches on Mill Lane and deliver to cafés, kitchens and offices across Bristol and the South West. No contracts, no minimum order after your first.

offers.heading: Three ways to buy
offers.intro: Every account starts with a free tasting and a bag on us. Pricing is per kilo and holds for twelve months.

items.name: Café
items.summary: Weekly delivery, a house espresso and one rotating filter, with a grinder dial-in on your first order.

items.name: Kitchen
items.summary: For restaurants pouring under ten kilos a week. Same coffee, fortnightly delivery, no minimum after the first order.

items.name: Office
items.summary: Ground to your machine, delivered monthly, with a loan grinder if you would rather buy whole bean.

beans.heading: What's on the roster
beans.intro: Three coffees we always have, and one bench lot that changes when the sack runs out.

image.alt: Hessian sacks stacked beside the roaster on Mill Lane

items.name: Arch Blend
items.note: Brazil and Colombia. Cocoa, toasted hazelnut, a soft finish. Our house espresso.

items.name: Guji Uraga
items.note: Ethiopia, natural. Blueberry and bergamot. Filter, and a very good flat white.

items.name: Huila Decaf
items.note: Colombia, sugarcane process. Baked apple and demerara. Nobody guesses.

items.name: Bench lot
items.note: Whatever is on the sample roaster this month. Ask and we'll send a bag.

visit.heading: Come and taste it
visit.intro: The roastery door is open on weekdays. There is no shop, but there is always a pot on.

enquiry.heading: Ask for a quote
enquiry.intro: Tell us roughly what you pour in a week and we'll come back with a price and a sample box.
